scope: repositories-only project context menu and retained-history visibility parity
cursorAgentObservations: Computer Use observed Cursor Agent project headers for both the current sciforge repository and a non-current Home repository.
Right-clicking those project headers exposed the same project-level menu: Mark All as Read, Archive All, and Remove from Sidebar.
Cursor keeps previous chats in the repository list after New Agent; the new draft does not push the just-retained previous chat out of the default visible area.
sciforgeIssuesFound: The SciForge project header context menu still contained older file/path-oriented entries such as Open in Finder and Archive chats instead of Cursor's three project-level actions.

Retained previous chats were stored correctly, but rendering appended retained history after all active threads, so a busy repository could make the previous chat look like it disappeared after creating a new draft.
sciforgeChanges: Changed the project header context menu to Mark All as Read, Archive All, and Remove from Sidebar only.
Kept Archive All wired to project-level archive behavior and Remove from Sidebar wired to existing project removal with the current-project guard.

Added a project-level Mark All as Read interaction that closes the menu and reports the visible repository chats as read; Round 30 supersedes this temporary notice-only behavior with persisted sidebar read-state.
Merged retained previous-chat history into the active repository thread sort before applying the visible window, so the just-retained previous chat stays near the new draft.
